name: Hybridshock
description: Hybridshock for TikTok Live events - supports PiShock and haptic reward workflows. Includes event mapping, pattern control, safety layers, queue management, and overlay support.
author: ltth.app Team

features.name: Shock API Integration
features.description: Full integration with PiShock and haptic reward workflows for shock, vibrate, and sound commands. Provider selection is available via dropdown.

features.name: PiShock Provider Support
features.description: Native PiShock integration with ShareCode management, op-code mapping, and automatic duration conversion (ms to seconds).

features.name: Device Management & Status Monitoring
features.description: Management of PiShock devices and haptic reward endpoints with real-time status monitoring and configuration.

features.name: Event Mapping System
features.description: Map TikTok events to shock actions with an extensible system.

features.name: Pattern Engine with 8 Presets
features.description: Preset patterns and custom sequences for complex effects.

features.name: Curve Generator
features.description: Generates curves in multiple modes: linear, exponential, sine, cosine, and custom.

features.name: Safety Layer with Multi-Level Limits
features.description: Multi-layer safety system with global, device-specific, and user-specific limits.

features.name: Queue System with Priority & Retry
features.description: Execution queue with priorities, retry handling, and load balancing.

features.name: Global/Device/User Cooldowns
features.description: Cooldowns on multiple levels to control command frequency.

features.name: Emergency Stop Function
features.description: Immediate deactivation of all shock devices in an emergency.

features.name: Whitelist/Blacklist System
features.description: User and device filtering through whitelist and blacklist mechanisms.

features.name: Follower Age Filtering
features.description: Filter commands based on follower age and account status.

features.name: Live Dashboard with Tabs
features.description: Clear dashboard with status, events, log, and settings tabs.

features.name: Event Mapper UI
features.description: User interface for managing and editing event mappings.

features.name: Pattern Builder UI
features.description: Visual editor for creating and editing custom patterns.

features.name: Safety Settings UI
features.description: Configurable interface for all safety parameters and limits.

features.name: Debug & Monitoring Tools
features.description: Comprehensive debug tools, logging, and performance monitoring.

features.name: High-End Overlay with Animations
features.description: Professional overlay display with animations, real-time feedback, and visual effects.

features.name: Import/Export of Mappings & Patterns
features.description: Export and import configurations, mappings, and patterns.

descriptions.en: Hybridshock for TikTok Live events - supports PiShock and haptic reward workflows. Includes event mapping, pattern control, safety layers, queue management, and overlay support.
descriptions.de: Hybridshock für TikTok-Live-Events - unterstützt PiShock und haptische Belohnungs-Workflows. Mit Event-Mapping, Pattern-Steuerung, Safety-Layer, Queue-Management und Overlay-Unterstützung.
descriptions.es: Hybridshock para eventos en vivo de TikTok - compatible con PiShock y flujos de trabajo de recompensas hápticas. Incluye mapeo de eventos, control de patrones, capas de seguridad, gestión de colas y soporte de overlay.
descriptions.fr: Hybridshock pour les événements TikTok Live - prend en charge PiShock et des workflows de récompenses haptiques. Inclut le mappage d'événements, le contrôle des patterns, les couches de sécurité, la gestion de file d'attente et le support d'overlay.
